edits.name: Blotato
edits.value: Turns one piece of content into a batch of posts across your social channels.

edits.name: Ideogram
edits.value: AI image generator that gets text inside images right, for posters, event graphics and quote cards.

edits.name: Granola
edits.value: Meeting notes from your own machine. Writes up what it hears, with no bot joining the call.

edits.name: Submagic
edits.value: Automatic captions for social video, turning a clip into a captioned, ready-to-post version in minutes.

edits.name: Seedance (ByteDance)
edits.value: ByteDance's AI video generator. Turns a text prompt or an image into short video clips.

edits.name: Gemini
edits.value: Google's consumer AI assistant app, with image generation, Deep Research and Gemini Live voice conversations.

edits.name: Gamma
edits.value: Turns an outline or prompt into a designed presentation, document or website.

edits.name: Grok
edits.value: AI assistant, free at grok.com and built into X, with current answers drawn from the web and X.
